cards.subtitle: 2 knockout favorites the market expects to control their ties, backed by their own attackers.
cards.explanation: This card backs the sides the market already expects to control their knockout ties, then adds attackers ON those favorites so the result and the upside pull the same way. In single-leg elimination football a clear favorite manages the game and protects a lead, which is exactly the script these result legs are priced for. Joint model probability ≈ 10% (Speculative) at a combined +838 — higher variance by design, 2 player leg(s) limited-data / market-implied until lineups post.
cards.expectedGameScript: Portugal are a slight favorite (53%) but this is a real contest; expect a measured first half and a game that opens up only if the favorite breaks through. Extra time is a live outcome (28% draw at 90'). Algeria are live underdogs being asked to defend and counter; the favorite carries the play but knockout nerves and a deep block keep the door open for a low-scoring upset.
